required_steps: Copy validated extended h3d_partition_dp.h and h3d_independent_plan.h into mutable router only together with explicit native assignment-kind handling. Sentinel opening.size() is an outside kind and must never reach channels_[table[c]]. New t_h3d_plan_leaf.outside_cost defaults infinity; plan.outside_leaves separate from physical groups.

Add immutable eta setting absent=disabled,0=exact same new plumbing with no benefit,.25=quality. Require Qs, zeroRC, edge encoding and trace during development; reject incompatible sensitivity/tie-pressure/margin/timing/bounded/physical-extra-score modes until supported. Same baseline source/query caps and current native physical costs.

Observer already computes valid paths/current raw cost at exact finite table point. Derive best valid raw per active eligible leaf and forward anchor->sink vector. In production lookup first intersects current expandable tree nodes with cache keys; do not scan every absent anchor. Keep intermediate and cross-net suffixes: each yielded1valid witness. Recompute current prefix/prices and tree intersection after prune; no new query.

Compute OutsideCost=max(raw,(1-eta)*bestPhysicalStandalone), invalid or unknown=infinity, refresh only. Preserve old physical table fingerprint as physical-only; log outside cost/kind/vector separately. Execute old physical probe_candidates_ before extended solver: it currently indexes planned.assignment as physical channels. Then solve extended table, keeping all old candidate diversity/legacy-distance work.

Prior assignment reevaluation must map intentional-outside state to sentinel and use current outside_cost; stale/invalid witness gives infinity. Extend trace_prior handling to distinguish intentional empty, avoid openings.at(sentinel) and physical branch lookups. Physical prior costs remain old exact.

Output assignment handles outside sentinel by clearing only target soft preference and saving bool retained_outside + complete current forward suffix metadata. Physical assignments clear that flag/vector. Existing active-target filter/non-target preservation remains; add new fields to explicit non-target equality assertions. Complete vector snapshots handle transaction/best restores, but verify them with a forced native rollback after outside state actually exists.

Feedback at VPR-already-selected net/remaining-target processing distinguishes intentional empty from missing. Revalidate expandable anchor, sink-layer/BB/simple suffix/current-tree exclusion. Invalid or overused recommended suffix may trigger existing cooldown/refresh machinery. Valid intentional empty alone must not cause repeated missing-guide refreshes. Criticality/path/native congestion triggers remain; no per-iteration all-net replan.

guide() still returns nullptr for intentional no-preference state; native legal branches/congestion/Tdel/STA stay unchanged. Final original guide CSV remains physical-preference rows only; add separate final outside descriptors from best-restored metadata, no fake RR channel for outside. Physical groups and actual SB/CB remain separately reported.

Run isolated eta0 exact native C/Qs gate, then count2 and count1 eta.25 paired trials (suggest C2/Z2/N2/N1 labels, avoiding legacyR1 name conflict), same source/budget/parameters. Verify firstlegal prefix across same new setting, actual graph/current context price/extended DP/acceptance and metadata/transaction restores. Compare matched A0/legacyR1/current C and keep all failure/timeout/missing states and full process cost. Only then expand or ablate independent DP/current-price contribution.
qualification: This recipe follows independently verified live captures/counterfactual; it is not native implementation or a promised quality gain. Previous goal turn is progress, active goal not complete. Original freeze remains intact.
